title: Kusanagi Nene — A Dream On A Melody〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me how I sound for the part where we're supposed to sing together, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kusanagi!
Can you tell me how I sound while delivering this line?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Kusanagi, I wanted to make sure we're coming on stage at the right time. Oh, I guess you have your hands full right now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
J-Just a second...
Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll be forcing them to wait, but I should help them in order here...)
We'll take care of things, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You help Ichika and the others.
We just so happen to be free right now, so I can assist with delivering lines and such.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can help you with your cue to take the stage, since that's my department.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys!
Would you all be okay with them helping instead, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Thank you for doing this, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line:
I also really appreciate it.
Thanks for offering to help, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line:
Anytime!
Of course.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thank goodness everyone ended up joining the musical...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They can keep practices and stuff going while I'm dealing with planning committee business, or checking up on the other teams.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can delegate to them whenever I'm suddenly swamped.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Emu's even helping the set designers...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I shouldn't lean on them too much.
As the leader, I need to keep doing my best.)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting. I'm ready to hear you sing now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great, thanks!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, let's take a break here!
Please make sure to stay hydrated, everyone.
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks again for helping me with the others earlier. So, was everything okay after that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ Everyone's thinking really hard about what their characters are supposed to be feeling☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Everything from their emotions to their personalities and all the other little things they do!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As for the cue to take the stage, I told them to do so when the music starts playing. That seemed like the simplest way for them to understand.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...
se_walk_women_005_3

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's like everybody wants your help, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even while we were practicing, people kept coming over to ask you for help. A part of me feels that they need to be more independent, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I'm the one who agreed to lead everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, I've been so busy that I've been delegating to Tsukasa and the others...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but being the leader doesn't mean you have to do everything yourself. Honestly, that sounds downright impossible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's a good leader's job to delegate when you feel it's necessary.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely! So, ask us for help whenever you need it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Ask us lots and lots☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Again, you guys, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, this might sound funny now... But can I ask you all about the next scene we're about to do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like we can get the musicians to leave a bigger impression on everyone when they initially appear.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, perfect. I was going to ask about that very scene too. It's when Lulu meets them for the very first time, after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I think their acting is already impactful enough as it is now. We may not want to make any drastic changes, considering how we only have a few days left until the show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know. That's why I wanna ask you guys about how much I should push.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like our leader isn't satisfied with our current performance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! But we've gotten pretty used to acting now, so feel free to ask us whatever!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we're willing to do anything if it'll make our musical better.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is quite the conundrum. If you were Tsukasa, then I'd gladly throw in some lightning and explosions...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Explosion?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? D-Did he just say explosions...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And lightning...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... But this is the musicians' first appearance.
Wouldn't it be fine to have explosions and lightning appear in the background?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Explosions in the background? They're not superheroes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this scene does have a big impact on Lulu, so maybe it would be good to have a visual representation of...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, wait!
No explosions or lightning!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't give me that look...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This isn't a Wonderlands×Showtime show.
It's an official event, so we can't just do what we normally do for these kinds of things!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Yes, fair point.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, the stage isn't exactly equipped to handle those kinds of effects anyway.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... Sorry, I know I asked for your input, but let's leave the big effects for when it's just us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Then, I'll try to think of something that you'd normally see at a school festival.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to scare any of you. We won't be doing any of those things, so don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, Kusanagi, you and your troupe do know how to put on amazing shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, based on what you were saying, it sounds pretty normal for there to be explosions and lightning?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And I've seen a few of your guys' shows...
Did I just happen to see the ones without any extravagant effects?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The ones Rui directs are chock full of them♪ For example... Mguh?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-If the story calls for it, then we'll throw in some effects. Not all our shows are like that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Shiraishi, you don't look all that surprised.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? I mean, I'm pretty used to hearing about Kamishiro making stuff explode at school, at this point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: During the cheering competition for the sports festival, he had people jump out of some classroom windows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Be it Rui or any of the others, their crazy ideas used to really startle me. But not anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Kind of amazing what you can get used to...)
